rules.rule_text: A fusion must use exactly one body_plan value from the Tier 1 allowed set: quadruped, biped, biped|winged, winged, finned, multi_legged, serpentine, radial.
rules.test_method: Check fusion body_plan is in the allowed set and is a single value.
rules.basis: radial added 2026-10-28 as a project decision for moon_jellyfish

rules.rule_text: A fusion's covering must be a covering of at least one donor parent (fur, feathers, scales, skin, exoskeleton, shell).
rules.test_method: Check fusion covering is in the union of parents' coverings.

rules.rule_text: A fusion may not assign two different coverings to the same body region without naming the region for each.
rules.test_method: Check covering list per region; flag any unlabelled double covering.

rules.rule_text: A winged fusion must have a winged or biped|winged donor; wings cannot be invented from a finned or serpentine donor alone.
rules.test_method: Check at least one parent body_plan contains 'winged'.

rules.rule_text: A finned fusion must have a finned donor; fins cannot be invented from a quadruped donor alone.
rules.test_method: Check at least one parent body_plan is 'finned'.

rules.rule_text: A serpentine fusion must have a serpentine donor; a limbless body cannot be invented from a quadruped donor alone.
rules.test_method: Check at least one parent body_plan is 'serpentine'.

rules.rule_text: A shelled fusion must have a shelled donor (covering=shell); a shell cannot be invented from a fur or feather donor alone.
rules.test_method: Check at least one parent covering is 'shell'.

rules.rule_text: A parent mass ratio above 1000x (larger parent maximum / smaller parent minimum) is an extreme-size conflict and must be flagged, not silently averaged.
rules.test_method: Compute max/min ratio; flag if >1000.

rules.rule_text: A source range must be kept as a range in any fusion table; a midpoint must never be computed from a range.
rules.test_method: Check value fields for ranges are stored as 'low-high', never a single computed midpoint.

rules.rule_text: A real hybrid's parents must be named by scientific name and role (father/mother), exactly as in Tier 1 hybrids.csv.
rules.test_method: Check parent1_scientific, parent2_scientific and roles are present.

rules.rule_text: A reciprocal cross (swapped father/mother) is a different hybrid from the original cross and must be recorded separately.
rules.test_method: Check mule vs hinny, liger vs tigon are distinct rows.

rules.rule_text: A fusion design inspired by a real hybrid must not claim the real hybrid's fertility unless its parents and cross direction match that hybrid exactly.
rules.test_method: Check fusion parents and direction against the real hybrid row before copying fertility.

rules.rule_text: A fusion's movement list must be a subset of the union of its parents' Tier 1 movement values.
rules.test_method: Check every fusion movement token appears in at least one parent's movement list.

rules.rule_text: A fusion may not claim 'fly' unless at least one parent moves by flying.
rules.test_method: Check 'fly' in fusion movement implies 'fly' in a parent movement list.

rules.rule_text: A fusion may not claim 'swim' unless at least one parent moves by swimming.
rules.test_method: Check 'swim' in fusion movement implies 'swim' in a parent movement list.

rules.rule_text: A fusion that combines a flying parent and a swimming parent must state which medium is primary; it may not claim both at full competence without a note.
rules.test_method: Check primary_medium field for fly+swim fusions.

rules.rule_text: A fusion's habitat list must overlap at least one habitat of each parent, or the non-overlap must be flagged as a habitat conflict.
rules.test_method: Compute habitat intersection per parent; flag empty intersections.

rules.rule_text: A fusion's climate list must overlap at least one climate of each parent, or the non-overlap must be flagged as a climate conflict.
rules.test_method: Compute climate intersection per parent; flag empty intersections.

rules.rule_text: A marine-only fusion must not be built from a terrestrial-only parent without a habitat-change note.
rules.test_method: Check marine claim against parent habitat lists.

rules.rule_text: A polar-climate fusion must have a polar donor or a stated insulation mechanism; polar cannot be invented from tropical-only parents.
rules.test_method: Check polar claim against parent climate lists.

rules.rule_text: A fusion combining a freshwater parent and a marine parent must state its salinity tolerance; it may not be assumed to live in both.
rules.test_method: Check salinity note for freshwater+marine fusions.

rules.rule_text: A desert fusion must have a desert donor or a stated water-conservation mechanism.
rules.test_method: Check desert claim against parent habitat lists.

rules.rule_text: A fusion's diet must be a diet of at least one parent, or a stated intermediate (e.g. omnivore from carnivore x herbivore) with a note.
rules.test_method: Check diet against parent diets, or check intermediate note.

rules.rule_text: A carnivore x herbivore fusion must not be recorded as purely carnivore or purely herbivore without a note; the default intermediate is omnivore.
rules.test_method: Check diet for carnivore x herbivore fusions.

rules.rule_text: A mythological creature row must name its culture, its component animals, and the part each animal contributes.
rules.test_method: Check culture, component_animals and component_parts are all present.

rules.rule_text: A mythological creature with any human component must have has_human_part=yes; all others must have no.
rules.test_method: Check has_human_part against component_animals containing 'human'.

rules.area_name: Fusion Design, Viability and Failure Modes
rules.rule_text: A fusion with a body_plan conflict (e.g. finned x quadruped with no amphibious design note) must be flagged, not silently resolved by picking one parent's plan.
rules.test_method: Check body_plan conflicts are flagged in test output.

rules.area_name: Fusion Design, Viability and Failure Modes
rules.rule_text: A fusion with no habitat overlap with a parent must be flagged as a habitat conflict in the test output.
rules.test_method: Check habitat intersection is computed and empty intersections are flagged.

rules.area_name: Fusion Design, Viability and Failure Modes
rules.rule_text: A fusion with a mass ratio above 1000x between parents must be flagged as an extreme-size conflict.
rules.test_method: Check mass ratio is computed and >1000x is flagged.

rules.area_name: Fusion Design, Viability and Failure Modes
rules.rule_text: A test round is clean only if every test fusion is evaluated, every rule check runs, and no fusion has a missing-data gap that was not logged.
rules.test_method: Check test_rounds.csv: all fusions evaluated, gaps logged.

rules.area_name: Fusion Design, Viability and Failure Modes
rules.rule_text: A design that uses a blank Tier 1 trait (value left blank for implausibility or absence) must treat that trait as unknown, never fill it from memory.
rules.test_method: Check blank-trait fusions carry 'unknown' for that trait, not an invented value.

rules.rule_text: A fusion combining a tundra parent and a tropical parent must state its thermal range; it may not be assumed to live in both extremes without a note.
rules.test_method: Check thermal-range note for tundra+tropical fusions.

rules.rule_text: A fusion with a wetland parent must not be recorded as purely terrestrial or purely aquatic without a note on its water dependence.
rules.test_method: Check water-dependence note for wetland fusions.

rules.rule_text: A fusion may claim movement 'walk' only if at least one parent's Tier 1 movement includes 'walk'.
rules.test_method: Check 'walk' in fusion movement implies 'walk' in a parent movement list.

rules.rule_text: A fusion that walks and swims must state whether it walks on land and swims in water, or whether one medium is primary.
rules.test_method: Check primary_medium for walk+swim fusions.

rules.rule_text: A fusion that climbs must have a climbing donor; climbing cannot be inferred from walking alone.
rules.test_method: Check climb claim against parent movement lists.

rules.rule_text: A fusion that burrows must have a burrowing donor; burrowing cannot be inferred from walking alone.
rules.test_method: Check burrow claim against parent movement lists.

rules.rule_text: A fusion that glides must have a gliding donor; gliding is not the same as flying and must not be recorded as fly.
rules.test_method: Check glide claim against parent movement lists; check glide is not stored as fly.

rules.rule_text: A fusion with no movement donor for a claimed movement must be flagged, even if the movement seems plausible for the body plan.
rules.test_method: Check every movement token against parents; flag unmatched tokens.

rules.rule_text: A fusion recorded in both freshwater and marine habitats must state its salinity tolerance explicitly.
rules.test_method: Check salinity note for freshwater+marine fusions.

rules.rule_text: A fusion recorded in a wetland must state whether it is aquatic, semi-aquatic or terrestrial in that wetland.
rules.test_method: Check wetland dependence note.

rules.rule_text: A fusion recorded with diet 'carnivore' must have at least one parent whose Tier 1 diet includes 'carnivore', or a stated intermediate with a note.
rules.test_method: Check 'carnivore' against parent diets or intermediate note.

rules.rule_text: A fusion with a metabolic_rate below 1 W and a body_mass above 1 kg must be flagged as implausible, as with serval 1.44 W.
rules.test_method: Check metabolic_rate against body_mass; flag implausible combinations.

rules.rule_text: A fusion with a 'temperate|tropical|polar' parent must not be recorded as living in all three climates unless each climate is separately justified; a broad parent range is not evidence for all three in the fusion.
rules.test_method: Check per-climate justification for broad-climate fusions.

rules.rule_text: A fusion combining a serpentine parent with a quadruped parent must state which body plan is primary and how limbs are handled; it may not be recorded as both serpentine and quadruped.
rules.test_method: Check primary body_plan and limb note for serpentine+quadruped fusions.

rules.rule_text: A fusion with a shelled parent and a fur parent must state whether the shell covers the whole body or a region; a whole-body shell and whole-body fur cannot both be claimed for the same region.
rules.test_method: Check shell coverage region for shell+fur fusions.

rules.rule_text: A hybrid's parent Tier 1 match must be recorded separately from its cross: a parent that resolves to the same GBIF species as another parent (e.g. dog and wolf) is not two distinct species for fusion purposes.
rules.test_method: Check parent Tier 1 match field for wolfdog-type hybrids.

rules.rule_text: A fusion combining a diurnal parent with a nocturnal parent must state its active_time as the overlap or as a design choice with a note; it may not be recorded as both fully diurnal and fully nocturnal.
rules.test_method: Check active_time overlap or design note for diurnal+nocturnal fusions.

rules.rule_text: A fusion with a 'carnivore|piscivore' parent must state whether fish are included; piscivore is not automatically included in carnivore.
rules.test_method: Check fish-inclusion note for carnivore|piscivore fusions.

rules.rule_text: A parent with active_time 'unrecorded' adds no tokens. The fusion's active_time is built from the other parents' values under R-A4-05, R-A4-06 and R-A4-P03. If every parent is 'unrecorded', the fusion's active_time is 'unrecorded' and the app shows it as 'activity pattern unknown'. 'unrecorded' never blocks a fusion and is never combined with other tokens.
rules.test_method: Drop 'unrecorded' parents, then check the remaining parents as usual; if none remain, check the fusion value is exactly 'unrecorded'.

failure_modes.example: Finned x quadruped fusion with no amphibious design note
failure_modes.mitigation: Flag as FAIL; add an amphibious design note or change a parent.
Flag as FAIL; pick a parent covering or name a new region.
Flag as extreme-size conflict; do not average.

design_principles.principle: Start from one parent's body_plan; do not blend two incompatible plans without an explicit design note.
Pick covering from a donor; do not invent a new covering for a fusion.
Keep fusion mass inside the parents' spanned mass interval, or flag it as a design extrapolation.

definitions.about: Definitions of every field and value in 'animals'. Lists use '|' and mean the animal has all listed values. Activity terms are standard biology terms; 'unrecorded', 'radial' and 'bell' are project terms.

fields.animal_id: Unique snake_case key used to join every section.
fields.class / order / family: Taxonomic ranks from GBIF. Reptiles and ray-finned fish use the traditional classes Reptilia and Actinopterygii (see blank_notes on those rows).
fields.gbif_key: GBIF species key; taxonomy_url points to its API record.
fields.body_plan: Overall body layout. Values: quadruped (four walking legs), biped (two walking legs), winged (wings are the main limbs), finned (fins are the main limbs), multi_legged (six or more legs or arms), serpentine (long body, no limbs), radial (body arranged around a central axis with no front or back, as in jellyfish).
fields.primary_locomotor_part: Body part mainly used to move: four legs, two legs, multiple legs, wings, fins, flippers, bell (jellyfish swim by pulsing the bell-shaped body).
fields.covering: Outer body surface: fur, feathers, scales, skin (bare skin), exoskeleton (hard outer skeleton, as in insects and spiders), shell.
fields.movement: Ways the animal moves: walk, run, swim, fly, climb, burrow (digs through ground), glide (unpowered flight).
fields.active_time: When in the 24-hour day the animal is usually awake and active. See active_time_values.
fields.habitat: Places it lives: grassland, forest, mountain, tundra, wetland, freshwater, marine (sea), desert.
fields.climate: Climate zones it lives in: temperate, tropical, polar, arid.
fields.diet: Main food: carnivore (meat), herbivore (plants), omnivore (both), insectivore (insects), piscivore (fish).
fields.metabolic_rate_w: Basal or resting metabolic rate in watts.
fields.body_mass_kg: Adult body mass in kg. A range stays a range; midpoints are never computed.
fields.body_length_m: Adult body length in m. Same range rule as mass.
fields.blank_notes: Why a value is blank or unrecorded, and any project decisions on the row.
fields.source_url: Page the trait values came from.

active_time_values.diurnal: Active mainly during daylight, rests at night.
active_time_values.nocturnal: Active mainly at night, rests during the day.
active_time_values.crepuscular: Active mainly at dawn and dusk (twilight).
active_time_values.unrecorded: No source used here gave an activity period. Not a claim about the animal: it may be any pattern. Under rule R-A4-P04 it adds nothing to a fusion and never blocks one. Replace it with a sourced value when one is found.

definitions.active_time_combinations: A list such as 'diurnal|nocturnal' means the animal is recorded as active in each listed period. 'unrecorded' is always used alone.
